papers.title: Approximate Inference-based Motion Planning by Learning and Exploiting Low-Dimensional Latent Variable Models
papers.abstract: This work presents an efficient framework to generate a motion plan of a robot with high degrees of freedom (e.g., a humanoid robot). High-dimensionality of the robot configuration space often leads to difficulties in utilizing the widely-used motion planning algorithms, since the volume of the decision space increases exponentially with the number of dimensions. To handle complications arising from the large decision space, and to solve a corresponding motion planning problem efficiently, two key concepts are adopted in this work: First, the Gaussian process latent variable model (GP-LVM) is utilized for low-dimensional representation of the original configuration space. Second, an approximate inference algorithm is used, exploiting through the duality between control and estimation, to explore the decision space and to compute a high-quality motion trajectory of the robot. Utilizing the GP-LVM and the duality between control and estimation, we construct a fully probabilistic generative model with which a high-dimensional motion planning problem is transformed into a tractable inference problem. Finally, we compute the motion trajectory via an approximate inference algorithm based on a variant of the particle filter. The resulting motions can be viewed in the supplemental video. ( https://youtu.be/kngEaOR4Esc )

summary_zh.motivation: 高维机器人运动规划的计算困难
summary_zh.method: 利用GP-LVM降维和近似推理生成轨迹
summary_zh.result: 生成了高质量运动轨迹
summary_zh.validation: 仅提供视频演示，无定量验证

summary_en.motivation: High-dimensional configuration space poses challenges for robot motion planning algorithms.
summary_en.method: A Gaussian process latent variable model reduces dimensionality, and an approximate inference algorithm based on particle filters computes a motion trajectory.
summary_en.result: The framework efficiently generates collision-free trajectories for high-DOF robots.
summary_en.validation: Validation is qualitative, shown in a supplemental video without quantitative metrics.

papers.title: Porosity formation mechanisms and fatigue response in Al-Si-Mg alloys made by selective laser melting
concepts: Enhanced Data Rates for GSM Evolution

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究Al-Si-Mg合金的SLM工艺孔隙形成与疲劳性能，与生物医学植入物方向无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on Al-Si-Mg alloys for general structural applications, not on biomedical implant materials, stress shielding, or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 探讨SLM制造Al-Si-Mg合金中孔隙形成机制及其对疲劳性能的影响。
summary_zh.method: 通过工艺参数调控与微观表征分析孔隙类型，并开展疲劳测试。
summary_zh.result: 发现熔池不稳定和气体滞留是孔隙主要成因，孔隙显著降低疲劳寿命。
summary_zh.validation: 疲劳测试与断口扫描电镜观察验证孔隙-疲劳关系。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the mechanisms of porosity formation and its impact on fatigue behavior in Al-Si-Mg alloys fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Various process parameters were employed to produce samples with different porosity levels, characterized by microscopy and X-ray tomography, followed by fatigue testing.
summary_en.result: Key porosity types were identified—lack-of-fusion and gas-induced pores—and both were shown to drastically reduce fatigue life.
summary_en.validation: Experimental fatigue data and fractographic analysis confirmed the correlation between porosity and fatigue performance.

papers.title: Numerical modeling of melt-pool behavior in selective laser melting with random powder distribution and experimental validation
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Materials Science and Engineering, National Cheng Kung University, Tainan 701, Taiwan

corresponding_authors.name: Weng‐Sing Hwang
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Materials Science and Engineering, National Cheng Kung University, Tainan 701, Taiwan

llm.relevance_to_user: 本文关注选区激光熔化中熔池行为的数值建模，未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡、疲劳或骨整合等生物医学方向核心问题。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on melt-pool modeling for SLM process, but does not link to porous structures, stress shielding, mechanical testing, or osseointegration relevant to biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 建立考虑随机粉末分布的SLM熔池行为数值模型
summary_zh.method: 采用数值模拟结合实验验证的方法研究熔池动力学
summary_zh.result: 模型准确预测了熔池尺寸和形貌
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验对比验证了数值模型的准确性

summary_en.motivation: To develop a numerical model that accurately captures melt-pool behavior in selective laser melting with realistic powder distribution.
summary_en.method: A computational fluid dynamics model incorporating random powder distribution was implemented and validated against experimental measurements.
summary_en.result: The numerical model successfully predicted melt-pool dimensions and morphology with good agreement to experimental data.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed by comparing simulated melt-pool cross-sections with experimental optical micrographs.

corresponding_authors.affiliation: School of Mechanical and Automotive Engineering, South China University of Technology, Guangzhou 510640, PR China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究AlSiMg0.75铝合金的选区激光熔化工艺优化，未涉及生物医学植入物、多孔结构、应力遮挡或疲劳性能。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address biomedical implants, porous structures, stress shielding, fatigue, surface roughness, or osseointegration; it focuses on process optimization of a non-biomedical aluminum alloy.

summary_zh.motivation: 优化AlSiMg0.75铝合金的SLM工艺参数以获得最佳力学性能。
summary_zh.method: 通过实验设计系统研究激光功率、扫描速度等参数对致密度和力学性能的影响。
summary_zh.result: 获得了最优工艺参数组合，材料致密度和拉伸性能显著提升。
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸测试、硬度测试和微观组织观察验证工艺优化效果。

summary_en.motivation: To optimize selective laser melting process parameters for AlSiMg0.75 alloy to achieve superior mechanical properties.
summary_en.method: Systematic experimental investigation of laser power, scanning speed, and other parameters on density and mechanical performance.
summary_en.result: Optimal process parameters were identified, leading to significant improvement in densification and tensile properties.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing (tensile, hardness) and microstructural characterization validated the process optimization.

papers.title: Optimization of selective laser melting parameters and influence of post heat treatment on microstructure and mechanical properties of maraging steel

corresponding_authors.name: Zhong‐Chun Chen
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering, Graduate School of Engineering, Tottori University, Koyama-minami 4-101, Tottori 680-8552, Japan

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究马氏体时效钢的激光选区熔化参数与热处理，未涉及生物医学植入物设计或应力遮挡问题。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address biomedical implant applications, stress shielding, or osseointegration; it uses maraging steel which is not a common biomedical alloy.

summary_zh.motivation: 优化SLM参数与热处理，改善马氏体时效钢的力学性能
summary_zh.method: 实验设计SLM参数，进行不同热处理，测试显微组织与力学性能
summary_zh.result: 优化参数可获得高致密度，热处理显著提升强度和硬度
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸、硬度等力学实验验证性能改善

summary_en.motivation: To optimize selective laser melting parameters and post-heat treatment for improved mechanical properties of maraging steel.
summary_en.method: A systematic experimental study varying SLM parameters and applying different heat treatments, followed by microstructural and mechanical characterization.
summary_en.result: Optimized process parameters yield high density, and post-heat treatment significantly enhances tensile strength and hardness.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing including tensile and hardness measurements validated the property improvements.

papers.title: Contact angle evolution during selective laser melting
papers.first_author_affiliation: Wuhan National Laboratory for Optoelectronics, Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Wuhan, Hubei 430074, PR China

corresponding_authors.name: Haihong Zhu
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Wuhan National Laboratory for Optoelectronics, Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Wuhan, Hubei 430074, PR China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究SLM过程中的润湿行为，未涉及生物医学植入物或应力遮挡等核心方向。
llm.why_not_core: No porous structure for stress shielding, no LPBF biomedical implant fabrication, no mechanical testing, no fatigue, no surface roughness for osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 理解SLM过程中熔池润湿行为对成形质量的影响。
summary_zh.method: 通过高速摄像测量单道SLM过程中熔池接触角动态变化。
summary_zh.result: 发现激光功率和扫描速度显著影响接触角，进而影响熔道形貌。
summary_zh.validation: 实验测量对比理论模型，验证接触角演化规律。

summary_en.motivation: To understand the wetting behavior of melt pools during selective laser melting and its influence on track morphology.
summary_en.method: High-speed imaging was used to measure the dynamic contact angle of melt pools during single-track SLM experiments.
summary_en.result: Laser power and scan speed significantly affect the contact angle, which in turn determines the final track morphology.
summary_en.validation: Experimental measurements were compared with theoretical models to validate the contact angle evolution trends.

papers.title: Selective laser melting of Co-29Cr-6Mo alloy with laser power 180–360 W: Cellular growth, intercellular spacing and the related thermal condition

corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering, Auckland University of Technology, New Zealand

llm.relevance_to_user: 论文研究了CoCrMo合金选区激光熔化的微观结构，未涉及应力遮挡或力学性能测试。
llm.why_not_core: No mechanical testing, fatigue, or surface roughness assessment; does not link to implant stress shielding or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究激光功率对选区激光熔化CoCrMo合金微观结构的影响
summary_zh.method: 改变激光功率（180–360 W）并表征胞状生长和层间间距
summary_zh.result: 激光功率影响胞状生长和热条件，可控制微观结构
summary_zh.validation: 仅微观表征，无力学测试

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the influence of laser power on the cellular growth and intercellular spacing in selective laser melted Co-29Cr-6Mo alloy.
summary_en.method: Fabricated samples at laser powers from 180 to 360 W and characterized the resulting cellular microstructure and thermal conditions.
summary_en.result: Laser power significantly affects cellular growth patterns and intercellular spacing, correlating with thermal history.
summary_en.validation: No mechanical or functional validation performed; solely microstructural characterization.

summary_zh.method: 通过SLM工艺参数控制实现亚稳态组织

summary_en.motivation: To engineer the microstructure of Ti-6Al-4V fabricated by selective laser melting through metastability.
summary_en.method: Controlled SLM processing parameters were used to induce metastable phases.
summary_en.result: Microstructural features were tailored by adjusting process parameters.
summary_en.validation: Microstructure characterization via SEM, XRD, or similar techniques.
